title: Weight Watcher Chicken Fried Steak
content:
Title: Weight Watcher Chicken Fried Steak
Category: < 60 Mins
Description: I am putting this in so I can get the nutritional info since Weight Watchers only lists points.  I have had this in the past and it was delicious.
Ingredients: lean beef round; all-purpose flour; salt; pepper; skim milk; bacon; onion
Instructions: Place steak between 2 sheets of waxed paper and pound to 1/2-inch thickness; slice steak into 4 equal pieces. Combine flour, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of pepper on a plate. Combine 1/4 cup of milk and egg white in a shallow bowl. Place bread crumbs on another plate. Dip a piece of steak in flour mixture; turn to coat both sides. Next, dip steak in milk mixture; turn to coat both sides. Lastly, dip steak in bread crumbs; turn to coat both sides and set aside. Repeat with remaining pieces of steak; reserve 1 tablespoon of leftover flour. In a large nonstick skillet, over medium heat, brown bacon, flipping once, about 5 minutes; remove from skillet and set aside. Add steaks to same skillet and place over medium-high heat. Cook about 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium, or longer to desired degree of doneness. Remove steaks and set aside. Off heat, coat skillet with cooking spray and set over medium heat. When hot, add onion; cook until tender, stirring occasionally, about 4 minutes. Add reserved tablespoon of flour; cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute. Pour in remaining cup of milk, scraping up any browned bits with a wooden spoon. Reduce heat to medium-low; add remaining 1/4 teaspoon of salt, 1/8 teaspoon of pepper and hot sauce. Crumble bacon; stir into skillet. Increase heat to medium and cook until gravy is thickened, stirring constantly, about 1 to 3 minutes. Spoon gravy over steaks and serve immediately. Yields about 3 ounces of steak and 1/4 cup of gravy per serving.

title: Easy Lettuce Wraps With Dipping Sauce
content:
Title: Easy Lettuce Wraps With Dipping Sauce
Category: Pork
Keywords: Meat; Asian; < 30 Mins; Easy
Description: Make and share this Easy Lettuce Wraps With Dipping Sauce recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: carrot; green onion; water chestnut; ground pork; chicken; soy sauce; iceberg lettuce; cooked jasmine rice; hoisin sauce; soy sauce
Instructions: Add vegetables to food processor until roughly diced. Add to skillet with sesame oil and saute until tender. Add pork and cook through, adding soy sauce as it cooks. Serve with lettuce, rice and dipping sauce. If you have extra meat filling leftover, it freezes very well.

title: Beef Sirloin Steak With Baby Spinach
content:
Title: Beef Sirloin Steak With Baby Spinach
Category: Steak
Keywords: Spinach; Greens; Vegetable; Meat; Low Cholesterol; Kid Friendly; Weeknight; < 60 Mins; Stove Top; Easy
Description: If you've never tried sirloin steak, give this family-pleasing version a try. It features a creamy sauce flavored with balsamic vinegar...and in just 40 minutes, you've got steak, veggies and potatoes ready to serve.
Ingredients: olive oil; boneless beef top sirloin steak; onion; garlic cloves; water; fresh rosemary leaves; dried rosemary leaves; mashed potatoes
Instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until well browned on both sides. Remove the beef from the skillet. Pour off any fat. Heat the remaining oil in the skillet. Add the onions and peppers and cook for 1 minute, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic and cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, stirring often. Stir the soup, water, vinegar and rosemary in the skillet and heat to a boil. Return the heat to medium. Stir in the spinach. Cover an cook the beef for 2 minutes for medium or until desired doneness. Serve the beef and vegetable mixture with the potatoes.

title: Beef-And-Portobello Minestroganoff
content:
Title: Beef-And-Portobello Minestroganoff
Category: Lunch/Snacks
Keywords: Vegetable; Meat; Low Cholesterol; Healthy; < 60 Mins; Stove Top; Easy
Description: Make and share this Beef-And-Portobello Minestroganoff recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: extra virgin olive oil; carrots; onion; mushroom caps; ground beef; chicken broth; crushed tomatoes; tiny pasta; sour cream
Instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the carrots and onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and browned, about 8 minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. Transfer the vegetables to a medium bowl. Add the beef to the pot and cook over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until browned, about 3 minutes; season with salt and pepper. Add the vegetable mixture, chicken broth and tomatoes. Stir in the pasta and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. Lower the heat to medium-low, cover and simmer until the pasta is tender, 10 to 12 minutes; season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with the sour cream.

title: Bean-Less Chili (Lo-Carb)
content:
Title: Bean-Less Chili (Lo-Carb)
Category: One Dish Meal
Keywords: Poultry; Meat; Very Low Carbs; < 4 Hours; Easy
Description: Easy "chili" without the beans for all phases of lo-carb dieting. NOTE** Substitute 2 lbs of either the ground turkey or beef with italian or chorizo sausage for a nice change-up!
Ingredients: ground turkey; ground beef; anaheim chilies; tomatoes; yellow onion; celery; garlic cloves; diced tomatoes; tomato sauce; ground coriander; cumin powder; chili powder; ground black pepper; salt; water
Instructions: Brown the meat in a large stock pot and drain. Add all other ingredients to the meat mixture and and bring to a boil. Turn down heat and simmer for an hour. Serve with shredded cheese, fresh avocado slices, sour cream or olives.
